newsitem.title: USA: IPO HIGHLIGHTS- Lason surges at IPO debut.
newsitem.headline: IPO HIGHLIGHTS- Lason surges at IPO debut.

text.p: Lason Holdings Inc surged 25 percent after its market debut Wednesday as investors clamored for a piece of its burgeoning industry.
Lason offers integrated outsourcing services for records and document management. Its shares rose 4-1/4 to 21-1/4 in early trading.

It offered 3.0 million shares which sold for $17 each in the initial public offering, better than their expected price tag of about $14.50 to $16.50 a share. Lason raised the amount of shares from an initial estimate of 2.7 million.
-- Splash Technology Holdings Inc shares eked out a 1/16 of a point gain to 11-1/16. The Sunnyvale, California company makes computer servers.
-- Chicago Pizza & Brewery Inc shares rose one to 6 from their IPO price of 5. The company offered 1.5 million shares of common stock and 1.5 million redeemable warrants.
